svg.title: EXPRESS OBSERVABILITY LAB
svg.desc: Express observability lab: an Express CRUD API instrumented with prom-client (request counter and latency histogram by method, route and status) and winston-loki logs, with Prometheus, Grafana and Loki run from Docker Compose. Dashboard visual is illustrative.
svg.text: Express CRUD API with prom-client metrics (request
counter + latency histogram by method, route, status)
